subject.title: Feature request: MEMORY.md size warning/limit enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw add core Control UI MEMORY.md budget display and save-time enforcement now, or fold the remaining hard-limit/archive behavior into the broader bounded-memory product work?
rationale: Current main already warns and diagnoses bootstrap truncation, but refusing saves or moving content into archives changes workspace-file editing and memory lifecycle behavior.

options.title: Define narrow core UI guardrail
options.body: Add a Control UI budget display and explicit over-budget save warning or block for MEMORY.md/bootstrap files, while deferring auto-archive semantics to the bounded-memory design.

options.title: Fold into bounded-memory work
options.body: Track hard limits and archive behavior under the broader bounded-memory issue and keep this issue as the MEMORY.md UI use case until that design is approved.

options.title: Keep diagnostics only
options.body: Declare prompt, doctor, and `/context` diagnostics sufficient for now and close the UI/save-enforcement request after maintainer confirmation.

recommendation.title: Define narrow core UI guardrail
recommendation.body: Add a Control UI budget display and explicit over-budget save warning or block for MEMORY.md/bootstrap files, while deferring auto-archive semantics to the bounded-memory design.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to both the bootstrap warning implementation and the Agents dashboard/file-editing surface this work would extend.
